name: ai-factory-trusted-verifier
description: Independently owned trusted verifier — oasdiff-based OpenAPI compatibility check, GitHub App, protected policies

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('curl -sSL https://github.com/tufin/oasdiff/releases/download/v1.35.0/oasdiff_1.35.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/oasdiff.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/oasdiff.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin oasdiff && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/oasdiff',{stdio:\"inherit\"});console.log('oasdiff installed')}catch(e){console.log('oasdiff install skipped:',e.message)}"
